**Verdict: PASS. I raised no new findings, so no findings sidecar was written.**

**Candidate.** The candidate ID `sha256:d8d831814a6065af8b417c862486dc2132ee6cca40bae0573f4918ff52e782c9` (2203 files) matches on both the repository and a complete, non-shallow clone.
- HEAD is the freeze commit `bd2e7f9`. It differs from source `54e02b6` only by delivery records: the three assignments, the candidate manifest and `stages.json`.
- Since round 2, only two e2e spec files changed (the test-only FE-RG2 repair). No product code changed.

**What I ran.** Everything ran on this candidate, in a disposable clone, in English and Arabic.

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| Validators: `--register DG5`, `--historical` DG4, DG3, DG2, DG1 | 5/5 PASS |
| `pnpm -r build` | exit 0 |
| Demo stack: the A02 and A21 acceptance specs plus my two probes | 16/16; probe steps 63/63 and 21/21 per language |
| Root acceptance specs on a production-initialized stack (A03–A22) | 30/30 |
| P5 web journeys | 72/72 |
| Integration tests (44 files, 26 more than round 2) | 519/519 |
| Unit tests | 89/89 + 132/132 |
| Production isolation probe | 0 demo records or users; seed-demo refused (exit 3) twice |

No cited log contains a failed, skipped, flaky or timed-out test. The only extra lines are `npm warn Unknown project config` (npm configuration warnings with no effect) and test titles that happen to contain words like "fail" or "error". Load reached about 17 during the runs, because all three reviews ran at the same time.

**Source fidelity and operating logic**
- **Playbook text:** my source comparison reports ALL OK against the playbook blocks: provenance (B0004), the four guiding questions (B0016), the Realize note (B0124), the launch windows (B0134), the six Day-90 questions (B0136–B0141), the roaming North Star (B0145), the three traceability chains read literally (B0147), the 25 health questions (B0150) and the score bands (B0152).
- **Exports:** all 22 exports carry the provenance statement (verbatim in English, the Arabic rendering in Arabic) and the illustrative label. None names DG0–DG7 or claims PMI status, and the Arabic files are right-to-left.
- **Screens:** I inspected them in both languages:
  - the reader with a provisional Arabic translation beside the verbatim source;
  - G1 with "Synthetic demonstration - approves nothing real";
  - the Studio badging G1–G6 as custom extensions;
  - the NPV/ROI extension off by default;
  - the rule dry run, with the human-only decisions refused as rule actions;
  - the health check at 17/25 in the 16–20 band;
  - an existing transformation pinned to the old form;
  - the KPI register reissued as v2, with the issued v1 unchanged.
- **Walkthrough on the seeded roaming record:** it shows step 1 as not completed. That is intended (ADR-0050 §7 completes step 1 only for a transformation created in the demo database), and all twelve steps complete on a new transformation in the e2e.
- **Navigation and claims:** areas are hidden server-side. The claims scan finds only disclaimers, and no DG reference appears in any catalogue.

**Decisions.** I accept D-163 (a), D-164 (a)–(k), D-165 (its accepted observations and the dev-mode demo sign-in), D-166 Rules A and B, D-167 and D-168. I re-read the Rule B code: it is a defined finish-to-start forward pass that stores nothing and shows Unknown when an input is missing, which meets M0232's "defined scheduling logic". The three observations accepted on the old branch are context only; I saw none of them as a defect this round.

**Environmental residuals.** These are recorded as PASS on the offline surface, with the residual named: the live registry and live CI, Keycloak or a real demo identity provider (the D-165 dev-mode binding was the test path), and the AI and notification adapters (none ships in P5).

**Findings:** none (no Critical, High, Medium or Low).

Files are in `docs/delivery/`:
- `reviews/DG5/round-3/domain-reviewer.json` (schema-valid; all 78 requirements; every evidence path exists)
- `test-evidence/DG5/domain/round-3/rg3/` (logs, probes, API bodies, exports, screenshots)

I removed the disposable clone and scratch files afterwards.
